markdown: - **AC**: Actual Cost (ACWP). Labor units actually spent to date, on every task. *(DoD EVM terms (Actual Cost of Work Performed); P6 Actual Labor Units)*
- **ACWP**: Actual Cost of Work Performed. DoD name of AC. *(DoD EVM terms)*
- **BAC**: Budget at Completion. Total budgeted labor units of the baseline. *(DoD EVM terms)*
- **BCWP**: Budgeted Cost of Work Performed. DoD name of EV. *(DoD EVM terms)*
- **BCWS**: Budgeted Cost of Work Scheduled. DoD name of PV. *(DoD EVM terms)*
- **BEI**: Baseline Execution Index. Tasks completed / tasks due by the status date (baseline finish on or before it); below 0.95 is flagged. P6's variant divides by every baseline task. *(DCMA-EA PAM 200.1 §3.1.2.4; P6 Check Schedule (BEI))*
- **BL**: Baseline. The reference schedule the update is measured against. *(P6 (BL columns))*
- **CPI**: Cost Performance Index. EV / AC; below 1 means the work earned cost more than budgeted. *(DoD EVM terms)*
- **CPL**: Critical Path Length. Working days from the status date to the forecast finish of the project. *(DCMA-EA PAM 200.1 §3.1.2.3)*
- **CPLI**: Critical Path Length Index. (CPL + total float of the finish) / CPL; below 0.95 is flagged. *(DCMA-EA PAM 200.1 §3.1.2.3)*
- **CSV**: Comma-Separated Values. Plain text table, one row per line. *(RFC 4180)*
- **DCMA**: Defense Contract Management Agency. US DoD agency; its 14-Point Assessment and DECM are schedule quality checks. *(DCMA-EA PAM 200.1)*
- **DECM**: DCMA EVMS Compliance Metrics. DCMA's current schedule metrics, identified by code (06A204b...). *(DCMA DECM v8.0)*
- **EAC**: Estimate at Completion. AC + ETC: labor units the work will have taken when done. *(DoD EVM terms)*
- **ETC**: Estimate to Complete. Remaining labor units. *(DoD EVM terms)*
- **EV**: Earned Value (BCWP). Baseline budget × Performance % complete: the budget of the work done. *(DoD EVM terms; P6 Earned Value Labor Units)*
- **EVM**: Earned Value Management. Measuring progress as budget earned against budget planned. *(ANSI/EIA-748)*
- **FF**: Finish to Finish. Relationship: the successor finishes after the predecessor finishes. *(P6)*
- **FS**: Finish to Start. Relationship: the successor starts after the predecessor finishes. *(P6)*
- **ID**: Identifier. Code of a task (P6 Activity ID), stable from one export to the next. *(P6)*
- **LOE**: Level of Effort. Task whose dates follow its relationships and that drives nothing (supervision...). *(P6 (Level of Effort activity type))*
- **MTA**: Milestone Trend Analysis. Forecast of each milestone at each update, plotted against the status date. *(xerscope)*
- **PAM**: Program Analysis Pamphlet. DCMA-EA PAM 200.1, home of the 14-Point Assessment. *(DCMA)*
- **PPC**: Percent Plan Complete. Starts (PPC Start), finishes (PPC Finish) or both (PPC W/W−1) planned at W−1 on or before W's status date that happened by then / those commitments; milestones and LOE left out. *(Last Planner (LCI) counts finishes only; xerscope adds starts. Commitments read from the W−1 forecast)*
- **PV**: Planned Value (BCWS). Baseline budget × Schedule % complete: the budget of the work planned to date. *(DoD EVM terms; P6 Planned Value Labor Units)*
- **SF**: Start to Finish. Relationship: the successor finishes after the predecessor starts. *(P6)*
- **SPI**: Schedule Performance Index. EV / PV; below 1 means less work done than planned. *(DoD EVM terms; P6 Schedule Performance Index)*
- **SS**: Start to Start. Relationship: the successor starts after the predecessor starts. *(P6)*
- **SV**: Schedule Variance. EV − PV; negative means behind plan. *(DoD EVM terms)*
- **TF**: Total Float. How long a task can slip without moving the project finish. *(P6)*
- **VAC**: Variance at Completion. BAC − EAC; negative means an overrun. *(DoD EVM terms)*
- **WBS**: Work Breakdown Structure. The tree the tasks are filed under. *(P6)*
- **wd**: working days. Working days of the task's calendar (project calendar for project totals). *(DCMA)*
- **XER**: Primavera XER. P6's tab-separated export file. *(Oracle)*
